title: Orchestration Inbox
purpose: Keeps a queue of requests waiting for Claude and other helpers.
description: Keeps a queue of messages from chosen Discord channels for 7 days. It reacts with an eye emoji so the sender knows the message arrived, and it never replies in the channel. Claude and other helpers read the queue through a protected local connection. It starts in test mode, where messages are saved but there are no reactions.
